# Software Engineering (Backend & Distributed Systems)

**For:** Engineering leads assessing backend, concurrency, data modelling and distributed systems depth.

Concurrency control, event-driven pipelines, protocol work and data models that stay correct under load.

## Role glossary

### A

**Abstract Syntax Tree (AST)**  
A tree representation of an expression or program. Transforming the tree rather than the text keeps every change structurally valid.  
*Projects:* [16 Expression Complexity Engine](../../projects/16-algorithmic-expression-complexity-engine/profile.md)  

**Adaptive Bitrate Streaming (HLS)**  
Video split into short segments at several quality levels so each viewer's player can switch quality to match their connection.  
*Projects:* [13 Livestreaming Platform](../../projects/13-low-latency-event-broadcast-platform/profile.md), [09 Geospatial Stream Dashboard](../../projects/09-geospatial-live-stream-intelligence-dashboard/profile.md)  

**Append-Only Ledger**  
A store where records are only ever added, never edited or deleted, so history can be replayed and audited.  
*Projects:* [01 Event-Sourcing Operations Hub](../../projects/01-event-sourcing-operations-hub/profile.md), [03 Competition & Prize Platform](../../projects/03-competition-prize-gaming-platform/profile.md), [16 Expression Complexity Engine](../../projects/16-algorithmic-expression-complexity-engine/profile.md), [18 Game Server RCON Orchestrator](../../projects/18-dedicated-game-server-rcon-orchestrator/profile.md), [21 Assisted Meal Delivery Platform](../../projects/21-nutritional-logistics-assisted-delivery-platform/profile.md), [22 Social Enterprise Portal](../../projects/22-non-profit-community-social-enterprise-portal/profile.md)  

### B

**Backpressure**  
Slowing or shedding incoming work when a downstream stage is full, instead of letting queues grow until something breaks.  
*Projects:* [01 Event-Sourcing Operations Hub](../../projects/01-event-sourcing-operations-hub/profile.md), [02 EPOS TCP Proxy Middleware](../../projects/02-epos-tcp-proxy-middleware/profile.md), [24 ChatOps Telemetry Microservice](../../projects/24-automated-chatops-telemetry-microservice/profile.md)  

### C

**Connection Pooling**  
Reusing a fixed set of open database connections instead of opening one per request, which caps load and cuts latency.  
*Projects:* [25 MEEN Full-Stack Scaffold](../../projects/25-monolithic-relational-fullstack-scaffold/profile.md), [17 DB Introspection Console](../../projects/17-dynamic-relational-db-introspection-console/profile.md)  

### D

**Dual-Database Isolation**  
Keeping credentials and audit data in a separate database from day-to-day business data, so routine backups and access never touch secrets.  
*Projects:* [08 Workforce Scheduling Engine](../../projects/08-enterprise-workforce-scheduling-engine/profile.md)  

**Dynamic Schema Reflection**  
Reading a database's own metadata at runtime to build views and forms, without generated models or ORM mappings.  
*Projects:* [17 DB Introspection Console](../../projects/17-dynamic-relational-db-introspection-console/profile.md)  

### E

**ESC/POS**  
The command language receipt and kitchen printers speak, including raster image modes.  
*Projects:* [02 EPOS TCP Proxy Middleware](../../projects/02-epos-tcp-proxy-middleware/profile.md)  

**Exponential Backoff**  
Waiting progressively longer between retries after a rate-limit or failure response, so clients recover without hammering the service.  
*Projects:* [24 ChatOps Telemetry Microservice](../../projects/24-automated-chatops-telemetry-microservice/profile.md), [19 Git Mirror Automation](../../projects/19-sovereign-git-continuous-mirror-automation/profile.md), [11 Headless Scraping Cluster](../../projects/11-distributed-headless-scraping-cluster/profile.md)  

### F

**Fail-Open**  
Choosing to pass traffic through unchanged when an optional processing step fails, because stopping service costs more than skipping the step.  
*Projects:* [02 EPOS TCP Proxy Middleware](../../projects/02-epos-tcp-proxy-middleware/profile.md)  

### H

**Headless Browser Automation**  
Driving a real browser engine without a screen (chromedp, Playwright) to render pages, extract data or print PDFs.  
*Projects:* [11 Headless Scraping Cluster](../../projects/11-distributed-headless-scraping-cluster/profile.md), [08 Workforce Scheduling Engine](../../projects/08-enterprise-workforce-scheduling-engine/profile.md)  

### M

**Merkle Tree**  
A tree of hashes that lets many documents be proven with one root hash, so batches can be anchored on-chain cheaply.  
*Projects:* [14 Web3 Notary Gateway](../../projects/14-decentralized-notary-web3-auth-gateway/profile.md)  

**Message Queue (BullMQ / Redis)**  
Handing slow work to background workers through a queue so the user-facing request returns quickly.  
*Projects:* [03 Competition & Prize Platform](../../projects/03-competition-prize-gaming-platform/profile.md)  

**Modular Monolith**  
One deployable application with clear internal modules. Simpler and faster to run than microservices when the team and load allow.  
*Projects:* [25 MEEN Full-Stack Scaffold](../../projects/25-monolithic-relational-fullstack-scaffold/profile.md), [12 Consultancy Routing Portal](../../projects/12-unified-multi-tenant-consultancy-routing-portal/profile.md), [22 Social Enterprise Portal](../../projects/22-non-profit-community-social-enterprise-portal/profile.md)  

**Multi-Tenancy**  
Serving many customers from one platform while keeping their data separate, here by schema, host or organisational scope.  
*Projects:* [05 OASIS Multi-Tenant SaaS](../../projects/05-schema-isolated-multi-tenant-saas/profile.md), [04 Capacity Modeling Engine](../../projects/04-cognitive-capacity-modeling-engine/profile.md), [06 AI Sandbox Control Plane](../../projects/06-autonomous-ai-sandbox-control-plane/profile.md), [12 Consultancy Routing Portal](../../projects/12-unified-multi-tenant-consultancy-routing-portal/profile.md)  

### O

**Optical Character Recognition (OCR)**  
Turning images of text into machine-readable text, here run in memory on decoded printer images.  
*Projects:* [02 EPOS TCP Proxy Middleware](../../projects/02-epos-tcp-proxy-middleware/profile.md)  

**Optimistic Concurrency Control**  
Letting edits proceed and rejecting any based on a stale version (HTTP 409), instead of locking records while people work.  
*Projects:* [08 Workforce Scheduling Engine](../../projects/08-enterprise-workforce-scheduling-engine/profile.md)  

### P

**Pessimistic Locking**  
Reserving a resource before using it so two buyers can never be given the same item, at the cost of some throughput.  
*Projects:* [03 Competition & Prize Platform](../../projects/03-competition-prize-gaming-platform/profile.md)  

### R

**Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)**  
Granting permissions to roles rather than individuals, scoped per tenant or domain (Casbin in OASIS).  
*Projects:* [05 OASIS Multi-Tenant SaaS](../../projects/05-schema-isolated-multi-tenant-saas/profile.md), [04 Capacity Modeling Engine](../../projects/04-cognitive-capacity-modeling-engine/profile.md), [07 Sovereign LXD Cluster](../../projects/07-sovereign-hybrid-cloud-lxd-cluster/profile.md)  

### S

**Schema-per-Tenant Isolation**  
Giving each customer their own PostgreSQL schema and selecting it per transaction, so a missed WHERE clause cannot leak another tenant's data.  
*Projects:* [05 OASIS Multi-Tenant SaaS](../../projects/05-schema-isolated-multi-tenant-saas/profile.md)  

**Server-Sent Events (SSE)**  
A one-way stream from server to browser over plain HTTP, used for live dashboards without WebSocket overhead.  
*Projects:* [01 Event-Sourcing Operations Hub](../../projects/01-event-sourcing-operations-hub/profile.md)  

**Smart Contract**  
Code deployed to a blockchain (Solidity on the EVM here) whose execution and results are publicly verifiable.  
*Projects:* [14 Web3 Notary Gateway](../../projects/14-decentralized-notary-web3-auth-gateway/profile.md)  

### V

**Verifiable Random Draw (PRNG)**  
Seeded pseudo-random selection with recorded inputs, so a prize draw can be proven fair after the fact.  
*Projects:* [03 Competition & Prize Platform](../../projects/03-competition-prize-gaming-platform/profile.md)  

### W

**Webhook**  
An HTTP callback one system sends another when something happens, used here as both an ingress and an alert channel.  
*Projects:* [01 Event-Sourcing Operations Hub](../../projects/01-event-sourcing-operations-hub/profile.md), [24 ChatOps Telemetry Microservice](../../projects/24-automated-chatops-telemetry-microservice/profile.md)  

**Workload Sharding**  
Splitting a large job (here IP ranges) into deterministic pieces that can run in parallel across machines.  
*Projects:* [10 Network Recon Pipeline](../../projects/10-high-throughput-network-recon-pipeline/profile.md)  

**Write-Ahead Log (WAL)**  
Writing changes to a log before applying them, so a crash never loses an acknowledged event. SQLite's WAL mode also allows readers during writes.  
*Projects:* [01 Event-Sourcing Operations Hub](../../projects/01-event-sourcing-operations-hub/profile.md)  

### Z

**Zod Runtime Contracts**  
Validating data shapes at runtime in TypeScript so a malformed event is rejected at the boundary instead of breaking the UI.  
*Projects:* [01 Event-Sourcing Operations Hub](../../projects/01-event-sourcing-operations-hub/profile.md)
